suite: G1 system health + G2 auth & session
observations: Logout does not invalidate the 15-minute access token; /auth/me still succeeds with it (stateless JWT trade-off).
Unknown routes under /api/v1 return the Express default (text/html) instead of the {success:false, error, statusCode} envelope.

results.title: GET /health returns service metadata without secrets
POST /auth/register creates organization + ADMIN and sets only the access cookie
notes: attributes: max-age=900 | path=/api/v1/auth | expires=wed, 21 oct 2026 10:05:00 gmt | httponly | samesite=lax

results.title: GET /auth/me accepts the access cookie and returns the session user
GET /auth/me also accepts Authorization: Bearer <access token>
notes: cookie and bearer transports are equivalent

results.title: POST /auth/login issues both HttpOnly cookies with the auth path scope
Login with an incorrect password returns the generic 401 message
Login with an unknown email is indistinguishable from a wrong password
notes: same message as G2-05 -> no account enumeration

results.title: Login with an empty password fails as 401 rather than leaking validation detail
Malformed credentials are rejected at the boundary with 400
notes: all four malformed inputs rejected without 500

results.title: Registering a duplicate email returns 409 and never exposes the hash
Passwords shorter than the policy minimum are rejected with 400
notes: Password must be between 12 and 128 characters.

results.title: Register rejects a missing organization name with 400
Cross-origin state change on /auth/register is refused with 403 (CSRF origin check)
notes: foreign Origin blocked before any DB write

results.title: Same registered-origin request is accepted (origin check is not over-blocking)
GET /auth/me without credentials returns 401
A tampered JWT is rejected by signature verification
POST /auth/refresh rotates the refresh token
Replaying a rotated refresh token is refused with 401
Refresh with no cookie or a malformed token returns 401
POST /auth/refresh enforces the CSRF origin check
notes: refresh cannot be driven from a foreign origin

results.title: Forgot password never confirms whether an account exists
notes: same message for both branches; token only in non-production

results.title: Reset with a weak password is rejected and does not consume the token
notes: password policy validated before the token is spent

results.title: A reset token cannot be replayed
Reset-password invalidates the old password and every live session
notes: all auth_refresh_tokens rows revoked inside the reset transaction

results.title: Reset with a malformed or unknown token is refused
Logout revokes the refresh token and is idempotent
notes: revoked server-side; repeat logout is a no-op by design

results.title: Access token still works after logout until it expires
notes: POST /auth/logout did not revoke the active access token (status 200)

results.title: Error envelope is consistent across auth failures
Unmatched API route does not return an HTML 404 inside a JSON client flow
